title: Booking Holdings unveils AI travel startup Vayo, based in Seattle, with a planned $100M investment
key_facts: Booking Holdings launched Vayo, its second AI-native startup, on Wednesday 14 Oct in private beta with a waitlist.
Booking plans to invest $100 million, subject to product progress and market conditions.
Vayo reads a traveler's inbox, collects confirmations from any brand including rivals like Expedia, and watches for price drops, gaps and schedule clashes.
At launch it organizes and monitors trips rather than booking them; direct booking is due within weeks, said CEO Mike Fridgen.
Its target users are frequent leisure planners, a single-digit share of travelers but 27% to 30% of spending, per Vayo's research.
Lola, Booking's other startup, was unveiled about two weeks earlier.
quote_evidence: Vayo, Booking Holdings' second AI-native startup, launched Wednesday in private beta with a waitlist at vayo.com.
Booking Holdings plans to invest $100 million in the startup, subject to continued advancement of the product and market conditions.
why_it_matters_hint: A big online travel company is testing an AI trip manager built outside its main brands.
